id.description: A string representing a UUID (universally unique identifier).

prefix.description: The unique prefix (or identifier) for this Vault configuration.

name.description: The name of the Vault that's going to be added.

description.description: The description of the Vault entity.

config.description: The configuration properties for the Vault which can be found on the vaults' documentation page.

created_at.description: An integer representing an automatic Unix timestamp in seconds.

updated_at.description: An integer representing an automatic Unix timestamp in seconds.

tags.description: A set of strings representing tags.
